options.D: The managers want to have a large team working for them to increase their status.

questions.questionText: What is necessary for price discrimination to be profitable in different markets?

options.A: There must be many buyers.
options.B: There must be markets with different price elasticities of demand.
options.C: There must be product differentiation.
options.D: There must be geographically separate markets.

options.A: the law of diminishing marginal utility
options.B: the law of variable proportions
options.C: fixed costs exceeding variable costs
options.D: technical diseconomies

options.A: rise rise
options.B: rise fall
options.C: fall rise
options.D: fall fall

questions.questionText: Which is not a reason for the existence of small firms in a market dominated by large companies?

options.A: Small firms can concentrate on providing specialist services.
options.B: Small firms enjoy greater economies of scale.
options.C: Small firms enter the market with new innovative ideas.
options.D: Small firms have good knowledge of local markets.

options.A: u + v B v + w C x D v + w + x

questions.questionText: In 2007 the United Kingdom’s government banned cigarette smoking in enclosed public spaces, such as offices, shops, bars and restaurants. What is a government failure arising from this ban?

options.A: decreased consumption of cigarettes by smokers
options.B: decreased levels of passive cigarette smoking by non-smokers
options.C: increased litter from used cigarettes outside offices and shops
options.D: increased sales of cigarette substitutes like nicotine patches and gum

questions.questionText: When does a more equal distribution of income occur?

options.A: when a country’s income tax system is made more progressive
options.B: when someone is made better off without making someone else worse off
options.C: when the best use is made of scarce resources
options.D: when there is an increase in the Gini coefficient

questions.questionText: What is likely to improve the occupational mobility of labour?

options.A: a decrease in income tax that increases aggregate demand
options.B: a decrease in unemployment benefit
options.C: an increase in retraining schemes for the unemployed
options.D: more advertising of employment vacancies in the economy

questions.questionText: What is not included in the Human Development Index?

options.A: infant mortality rates
options.B: gross national income per capita
options.C: life expectancy at birth
options.D: mean years of schooling

questions.questionText: Under what circumstances will low wages and low-cost land in a developing country not attract foreign investment in manufacturing?

options.A: if the developing country creates genuine independence for their central banks
options.B: if the developing country embarks on a programme of privatisation
options.C: if the developing country lacks well-developed infrastructure
options.D: if the developing country permits repatriation of profits

questions.questionText: An individual was temporarily unemployed but found a job quickly. What type of unemployment is this?

options.A: cyclical unemployment
options.B: frictional unemployment
options.C: seasonal unemployment
options.D: structural unemployment
